concept: ネオン以外を含む複数の方向性で、ComfyUI の出力品質が LLM 側（GenerateImage）に対してどれだけ落ちるかを見る
note: 品質ギャップの検証（nature）。LLM 側の探索セット 05 と同じセル指定の偶数番 12 件を ComfyUI で生成。参考列は LLM 側 24 枚全体の仕分け結果。SD1.5 は XL との比較用。

conditions.name: xl-05-nature
conditions.prompt_prefix: non-geometric organic flat graphic decoration, plants, animals, water, clouds, hand-drawn ink and screen-print texture, warm ivory and dusty indigo palette, edge to edge, full frame composition
conditions.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, people, face, photo, mockup, perspective grid floor, frame, border
conditions.reference: like 14 / dislike 7 / maybe 3（24 枚中 like 58%）

items.text: loose botanical stems with wild meadow flowers
hand-drawn moths among delicate fern fronds

foxes and tall grasses in a folk-art landscape
